before.description: Elana Beiser is a attorney representing WWL-TV. Orleans Parish deputies handcuffed and detained them in New Orleans on July 2, 2026, during a dispute over press access to a closed court proceeding. The U.S. Press Freedom Tracker reported approximately 20 minutes in custody followed by release without booking.
